d: Abhiman gyanpith puraskar se sammanit aashapurna devi ke upanyas "jar badle ja" (prarabdh) par aadharit dharavahik hai | kisi bhi rishte ki khubsurti aapsi samajh,vishvas aur pyar par tiki hoti hai | pati-patni ke rishton ki dor ek mahin dhage se juri hoti hai,agar dhage men ganth par jae to rishton ki khubsurti tar-tar ho jati hai| saugat mukharji aur ganga ka rishta bhi pyar se labalab bhara huaa tha lekin ek galatfahmi aur ahankar ke karan donon ke bich talaq ho jata hai | bat bachchon ke bantvare tak aa jati hai | beti man ke hisse aur beta bap ke hisse men aata hai | jab rishta tutta…
